nodes.bounded_responsibility: Create run identity, pin graph version and exact product scope, and persist the initial checkpoint.
prohibited_actions: Do not infer missing SKU or variant
Do not start downstream work before identity is pinned
nodes.idempotency_policy: One run_id per exact initialization request; repeat returns the existing initial checkpoint.
nodes.timeout_policy: No autonomous waiting; unresolved identity becomes blocked.
nodes.retry_policy: Retry only after corrected identity input.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Mandatory initial checkpoint before any agent node.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Select and record only the route allowed by 00A for the exact SKU Passport stage.
prohibited_actions: Do not perform another agent's work
Do not accept a package on behalf of the receiver
Do not route a file outside 00A
nodes.idempotency_policy: Same stage and pinned inputs return the same route decision.
nodes.timeout_policy: Stop when required contract input or owner decision is absent.
nodes.retry_policy: Re-enter after an accepted receiver receipt or corrected package.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Checkpoint every accepted handoff and route decision.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Collect and systematize maximal product evidence into the single canonical Passport candidate.
prohibited_actions: Do not create a second Passport
nodes.idempotency_policy: Write only a new Passport version bound to base version and change event.
nodes.timeout_policy: Return a bounded gap state when evidence cannot be obtained.
nodes.retry_policy: Delta-only update after new evidence or approved answer.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Checkpoint source manifest before write and read back changed sections after write.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Validate Passport package structure, registered files, metadata and response coverage without semantic approval.
nodes.idempotency_policy: Same input hashes produce the same validation result.
nodes.timeout_policy: Fail closed on unreadable or incomplete package.
nodes.retry_policy: Rerun only after package hash changes.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist validator version, input hashes and terminal output.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Independently identify material content, source and contradiction gaps in the accepted Collector package.
prohibited_actions: Do not create intake gates outside the contract
Do not block content for optional compliance documents
nodes.idempotency_policy: Audit is bound to one exact Passport and source-manifest hash set.
nodes.timeout_policy: Return bounded NV/GAP rather than fabricate evidence.
nodes.retry_policy: Only by user request or changed Passport/evidence package.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist exact audited paths and hashes.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Obtain targeted answers or evidence for registered gaps and return an approved candidate delta.
prohibited_actions: Do not close a gap without evidence
Do not run automatically after every edit
nodes.idempotency_policy: Stable question IDs and answer/source/evidence IDs prevent duplicate closure.
nodes.timeout_policy: Wait only through explicit human-return workflow; no implicit approval.
nodes.retry_policy: Repeat only by user request or returned evidence event.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist question lifecycle and returned-source hashes.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Apply only an approved candidate or media delta to the same canonical Passport and verify the write.
prohibited_actions: Do not apply unapproved candidate values
Do not launch Auditor or Verifier automatically
nodes.idempotency_policy: Change event and base version prevent applying the same delta twice.
nodes.timeout_policy: Block on locked document or changed base hash.
nodes.retry_policy: Retry after lock release or explicit rebase.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Mandatory pre-write base hash and post-write section read-back.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Confirm exact SKU, collection scope, requested sources and product artifact root before internet collection.
prohibited_actions: Do not authorize unrelated external writes
nodes.idempotency_policy: Decision is scoped to one collection_id and exact request hash.
nodes.timeout_policy: Remain waiting without interpreting silence as approval.
nodes.retry_policy: Resubmit only when request scope changes.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist owner, scope, time and request hash.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Discover internet media by public model name, collect obtainable content and comments, and register obtained and unobtainable sources.
prohibited_actions: Do not create new marketing content
Do not search only by internal SKU
nodes.idempotency_policy: Source URL, download attempt and content hash are stable; recovery is source-ID delta only.
nodes.timeout_policy: Record source-level access reason and continue eligible discovery surfaces.
nodes.retry_policy: Delta retry only for named unresolved source IDs.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Checkpoint after each immutable source record and before media processing.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Independently review discovery coverage, lineage, product identity and collection limitations before human acceptance.
prohibited_actions: Do not mark inaccessible content as collected
nodes.idempotency_policy: Review is bound to one manifest and collection-root hash set.
nodes.timeout_policy: Return explicit limitation instead of indefinite review.
nodes.retry_policy: Review only changed source IDs plus affected aggregate checks.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist reviewed manifest hash and exact source scope.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Validate manifest v0.5 structure and fail-closed collection invariants.
nodes.idempotency_policy: Same schema, validator and manifest hashes produce the same verdict.
nodes.timeout_policy: Fail closed on parser or schema error.
nodes.retry_policy: Rerun only after manifest or validator change.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist schema, validator and manifest hashes.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Authorize the on-request Content TZ scope, marketplace, locale, deliverables and readiness target.
nodes.idempotency_policy: Approval is bound to exact request and Passport hashes.
nodes.timeout_policy: Remain waiting; silence is not approval.
nodes.retry_policy: Resubmit only after scope or inputs change.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist owner, exact scope and pinned Passport hash.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Create an executable channel- and locale-specific Content TZ from accepted Product Truth and standards.
nodes.idempotency_policy: Output version is bound to exact request, Passport and standards baseline hashes.
nodes.timeout_policy: Return input blocker instead of filling material gaps by assumption.
nodes.retry_policy: Targeted rework only for classified TZ defects.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Checkpoint accepted inputs and each approved TZ version.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Independently validate Content TZ, Expected Deliverables Draft, their cross-artifact parity, module routing and required marketplace fields.
prohibited_actions: Do not generate expected deliverables from outputs
nodes.idempotency_policy: Same TZ, schemas and validator hashes produce the same structural result.
nodes.timeout_policy: Fail closed on unavailable dependency or parser error.
nodes.retry_policy: Rerun only after TZ or validator change.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist exact TZ, schema and validator hashes.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Review accepted Content TZ and either accept unchanged, submit a new editable revision for revalidation, return exact changes to the agent or cancel the run.
prohibited_actions: Do not silently change deliverable scope
nodes.idempotency_policy: Decision is bound to exact Content TZ, Expected Deliverables Draft, package-validation hashes and launch-control ID.
nodes.timeout_policy: Remain WAITING_HUMAN_DECISION; silence is not acceptance.
nodes.retry_policy: Resubmit after a new Content TZ version or explicit review decision.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist reviewed and resulting revision hashes, changed fields, requested changes, reviewer and decision time.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Close the current Content TZ run after an explicit owner CANCEL decision.
prohibited_actions: Do not treat cancellation as publication approval
nodes.idempotency_policy: One cancellation checkpoint per exact review receipt hash.
nodes.timeout_policy: STOP as CANCELLED; no automatic resume.
nodes.retry_policy: No retry; a future content request creates a new run.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist terminal CANCELLED status and exact owner decision receipt.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Create and verify an editable external Content TZ export package bound to the canonical validated Content TZ.
prohibited_actions: Do not send the export externally
Do not convert export readiness into publication approval
nodes.idempotency_policy: One export package per canonical Content TZ hash, format, locale and export version.
nodes.timeout_policy: STOP and return EXTERNAL_TZ_EXPORT_FAIL when local export or hash verification cannot complete.
nodes.retry_policy: Retry once only after classified local export failure; never recreate canonical Content TZ.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist canonical, export and export-manifest hashes; no production resume cursor.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Perform exact authorized external delivery or expose a local handoff package, then close the run.
prohibited_actions: Do not modify canonical or export content
Do not resume this run into production
nodes.idempotency_policy: One delivery disposition per exact export hash, recipient, method and authority ref.
nodes.timeout_policy: WAIT for explicit delivery authority; silence is not authorization.
nodes.retry_policy: Retry external delivery only after reconciliation proves no prior delivery; local handoff is idempotent.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist terminal delivery disposition and exact external receipt when applicable.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Freeze the complete expected deliverable set before Prompt Agent handoff.
prohibited_actions: Do not infer expectations from produced files
Do not silently rename, merge, split or remove expected assets
nodes.idempotency_policy: One frozen manifest version per accepted Content TZ hash.
nodes.timeout_policy: Block when mandatory expected fields remain unresolved.
nodes.retry_policy: Create a new manifest version only through approved TZ change.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist Content TZ hash, manifest hash and freeze event.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Transform the frozen expected deliverable set, Product Truth and available media registry into complete generation-input routes for Prompt Agent.
prohibited_actions: Do not change frozen deliverable scope
Do not perform legal or publication clearance
Do not let Prompt Agent select source semantics
nodes.idempotency_policy: Outputs are bound to exact Content TZ, expected manifest, Product Truth and media-registry hashes.
nodes.timeout_policy: Return a classified Content TZ blocker; do not request human approval for ordinary source routing.
nodes.retry_policy: Bounded reroute only for affected expected_asset_id after classified input or route defect.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist semantic-scope hash, expected-manifest hash, Product Truth hash, assessment hashes, route hashes and EXECUTION_INPUTS_FROZEN event.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Resolve the registered Prompt Agent package, installed skill, version parity, active adapter, callable entrypoint and admissible handoff before compilation.
prohibited_actions: Do not call a generation provider
Do not treat file presence as callability
Do not retry resolution more than once
nodes.idempotency_policy: Resolution is bound to canonical and installed skill hashes, registry versions, adapter entrypoint and input receipt hash.
nodes.timeout_policy: Return AGENT_RUNTIME_BLOCKED after one failed reload/re-resolve attempt.
nodes.retry_policy: Exactly one E184 reload/re-resolve is allowed; preserve upstream execution inputs.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist package paths/hashes, registry and adapter status, reload count and resolution verdict.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Compile one accepted Content TZ into traceable provider-ready prompt packages without changing strategy or Product Truth.
prohibited_actions: Do not change approved TZ semantics
nodes.idempotency_policy: Package identity is bound to exact Content TZ, reference and capability-registry hashes.
nodes.timeout_policy: Return INPUT_BLOCKED when a valid provider-visible compilation cannot be produced.
nodes.retry_policy: Targeted correction only for classified compilation defect.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist exact TZ, references, capability snapshot and package hashes.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Validate prompt input, output schema, atomic semantic coverage and shared-contract regressions.
prohibited_actions: Do not convert validation PASS into generation approval
nodes.idempotency_policy: Same package, schemas and validator hashes produce the same result.
nodes.timeout_policy: Fail closed on parser, schema or dependency error.
nodes.retry_policy: Rerun only after package or validator change.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist package and validator hashes.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Validate one asset run input, provider capability, sealed execution record and authorized cost boundary before a provider call.
prohibited_actions: Do not infer access or credentials
nodes.idempotency_policy: Preflight is deterministic for one run input and capability snapshot.
nodes.timeout_policy: Fail closed on missing provider, approval, credential or cost evidence.
nodes.retry_policy: Rerun after corrected input or capability state.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Mandatory checkpoint immediately before provider invocation.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Evaluate run-scoped provider execution policy, provider/model allowlist, credentials and remaining call/cost limits before each one-asset invocation.
prohibited_actions: Do not mutate prompts or upstream artifacts
Do not infer credentials, price or authority
nodes.idempotency_policy: Same policy hash, sealed asset hash, provider/model, ledger counters and estimated cost produce the same verdict.
nodes.timeout_policy: Fail closed when authority, credentials, capability, price estimate or ledger is missing.
nodes.retry_policy: Re-evaluate after a new or corrected bounded authority policy without rerunning unchanged Passport, Content TZ or Prompt Package stages.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Record one authority receipt before every provider invocation; retain policy hash and current ledger counters.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Evaluate the immutable run budget and current usage before each new provider side effect.
prohibited_actions: Do not alter the budget or reset usage
Do not spend the untouchable buffer
nodes.idempotency_policy: Same budget version, run fingerprint, counters and next-call estimate produce the same verdict.
nodes.timeout_policy: Fail closed when cost or quota cannot be bounded by an approved call-count cap.
nodes.retry_policy: Re-evaluate after terminal invocation reconciliation or a versioned budget authority update; never reset usage.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist one budget receipt before every new provider invocation and retain all counters and budget version.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Resolve one exact callable provider adapter for one authorized asset from policy, host capability, credentials, operation and reference requirements.
prohibited_actions: Do not read or persist credential secrets
Do not mutate prompt, parameters or references
Do not substitute video with animated still
nodes.idempotency_policy: Same registry, policy, authority, sealed input and host capability hashes produce the same resolution.
nodes.timeout_policy: Fail closed when entrypoint, credentials, capability or pricing is unavailable.
nodes.retry_policy: Re-resolve after a fresh host capability snapshot or registry update; do not rerun upstream content stages.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist exact adapter ID/version, entrypoint, registry hash and zero-side-effect receipt before provider execution.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Select one-time commissioning or admitted bounded production for the exact adapter fingerprint.
prohibited_actions: Do not self-admit without real output and QA receipt
nodes.idempotency_policy: Exact fingerprint and admission registry hash produce the same admission verdict.
nodes.timeout_policy: Fail closed when admission evidence or registry binding is unavailable.
nodes.retry_policy: Re-evaluate after valid commissioning evidence or admission registry update.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist execution profile, fingerprint and commissioning/production limits before call.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Acquire an exclusive exact-asset operation lease, return an existing terminal result idempotently, or require reconciliation before provider execution.
prohibited_actions: Do not overwrite an existing canonical version
Do not treat expired lease as proof of no provider call
nodes.idempotency_policy: One exact run, asset, operation, fingerprint and sealed record binding has at most one active owner and one provider invocation.
nodes.timeout_policy: Expired lease after provider acceptance requires reconciliation; no automatic takeover.
nodes.retry_policy: Re-acquire only after NOT_STARTED is proven or return the existing terminal result.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist lease owner, binding, expiry, invocation state and atomic commit receipt.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Execute exactly one approved provider call for one asset and persist returned output and terminal execution receipt.
prohibited_actions: Do not call provider without sealed preflight
nodes.idempotency_policy: One internal_invocation_id equals one asset and one provider call; reconcile before any retry.
nodes.timeout_policy: Unknown provider outcome requires reconciliation, not immediate retry.
nodes.retry_policy: Only within approved max_attempts, cost_limit and same prompt hash after classified technical failure.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Sealed pre-call checkpoint and terminal reconciliation receipt are mandatory.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Validate saved files, hashes, invocation lineage and one-asset output manifest after execution.
prohibited_actions: Do not create missing provider output
nodes.idempotency_policy: Manifest is derived from immutable execution receipt and actual file hashes.
nodes.timeout_policy: Fail closed on missing or unreadable output.
nodes.retry_policy: Rebuild manifest only; never repeat provider call from this node.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist final file hashes and reverse trace to Prompt Package and Content TZ.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Apply approved deterministic overlays, compositing, localization, color, audio and export operations without altering protected Product Truth.
prohibited_actions: Do not invent product geometry or text
Do not use finishing as generation
nodes.idempotency_policy: Finishing recipe, inputs and tool version define a reproducible export identity.
nodes.timeout_policy: Block when required overlay, font, locale copy or tool capability is missing.
nodes.retry_policy: Rerender only after classified finishing defect or input change.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist project/timeline ID, operations, input/output hashes and export preset.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Independently inspect each actual final image or video and return factual content QA findings and set completeness.
nodes.idempotency_policy: QA verdict is bound to exact final-export hashes, Content TZ and expected manifest.
nodes.timeout_policy: STOP PASS evaluation; emit an inspection-exception receipt and ESCALATE input/evidence blockers to N224. Silence is not completion.
nodes.retry_policy: RETRY only a transient technical inspection failure through bounded E263 with new attempt evidence and termination-budget allowance; RETURN input defects through N224; exhausted retry becomes FAILED_EXHAUSTED.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist inspected output hashes, locators, standard versions and factual verdicts.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Apply critical non-averaging asset QA and full-package completeness policy to inspected outputs.
nodes.idempotency_policy: Exact output hashes, QA facts, standard version and expected manifest produce the same verdict.
nodes.timeout_policy: Return QA_INCONCLUSIVE or CONTENT_PACKAGE_INCOMPLETE; never infer PASS.
nodes.retry_policy: Re-evaluate only affected asset and package dependencies after evidence or output changes.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist five group results, critical gate, confidence, finishing plan and package completeness.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Classify a QA defect into asset, affected dependency scope, upstream rework or batch circuit breaker.
prohibited_actions: Do not edit Product Truth or Content TZ
nodes.idempotency_policy: Exact QA hash, dependency bindings, defect history and runtime signals produce the same verdict.
nodes.timeout_policy: Fail closed to BATCH_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_OPEN when critical facts are unresolved.
nodes.retry_policy: Re-evaluate only after QA evidence, dependency binding or incident resolution changes.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist exact blocked and continuable asset scopes plus reason codes.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Resolve a finishing blocker or open circuit breaker without waiving failed QA or silently repeating the same defect route.
prohibited_actions: Do not repeat E245 for the same defect fingerprint
nodes.idempotency_policy: Decision is bound to exact defect fingerprint, evidence hashes, affected asset scope and prior attempts.
nodes.timeout_policy: Remain blocked; silence is not approval and does not reopen E245.
nodes.retry_policy: Reconsider only after a new evidence hash, corrected upstream input or explicit scope decision.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist fingerprint, attempt history, blocked scope, owner and route decision.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Continue one exact next asset after automatic QA PASS while admission and bounded limits remain valid.
prohibited_actions: Do not continue after unknown provider outcome
Do not bypass configured human checkpoint
nodes.idempotency_policy: Exact QA hash, remaining set, admission fingerprint and limit counters produce the same verdict.
nodes.timeout_policy: Open circuit breaker on unresolved input.
nodes.retry_policy: Re-evaluate only after the blocking evidence or owner checkpoint changes.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist exact completed asset, remaining set, next asset and all circuit-breaker checks.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Decide whether exact remaining asset IDs may proceed after immutable pilot QA PASS.
nodes.idempotency_policy: Decision binds exact pilot hash and explicit remaining asset IDs.
nodes.timeout_policy: Batch remains stopped while decision is absent.
nodes.retry_policy: New decision required after pilot or remaining-set change.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist owner, time, pilot hash and allowed remaining IDs.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Reconcile the final deliverables manifest, files, QA, lineage, leases, provider invocations, budget and checkpoint before production completion.
prohibited_actions: Do not mark an incomplete expected set DONE
Do not discard QA-passed partial assets
Do not close with active lease or unresolved invocation
Do not grant release or publication authority
nodes.idempotency_policy: Same exact final manifest and reconciled ledgers produce the same immutable closeout verdict.
nodes.timeout_policy: STOP closeout and ESCALATE unresolved blockers through E287 to N224; never infer completion or waive stale QA.
nodes.retry_policy: RETRY through bounded E288 only after a changed evidence fingerprint, new evidence and termination-budget allowance; zero progress or exhaustion becomes FAILED_EXHAUSTED.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist immutable final manifest binding and exact closeout receipt before human final content acceptance.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Personally review the exact QA-passed final image/video set and accept it for human-controlled use, request a documented correction, or reject the current revision.
prohibited_actions: Do not infer marketplace upload authority
Do not place final content on HOLD
Do not choose the correction agent instead of N223
nodes.idempotency_policy: Decision is bound to exact output-package hashes, channel, market and policy scope; the same revision decision is immutable.
nodes.timeout_policy: WAIT in WAITING_HUMAN_FINAL_ACCEPTANCE; absence of response is not HOLD, acceptance, upload or publication authority.
nodes.retry_policy: RETURN through E291 to N223 only with a valid correction request; re-review only after affected-scope correction, QA and closeout create a new revision.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist reviewer, exact package/asset hashes, decision and correction request when applicable; no platform action is performed.

nodes.bounded_responsibility: Persist exact checkpoints and select a safe resume, reconciliation, targeted re-entry or full-restart disposition without repeating side effects.
prohibited_actions: Do not repeat provider or external side effects
Do not change SKU, Product Truth or graph version silently
Do not grant provider, spend, release or publication authority
nodes.idempotency_policy: Checkpoint ID and state hash are immutable; same exact recovery inputs produce the same disposition and never repeat a side effect.
nodes.timeout_policy: Remain in the exact waiting or reconciliation state when external state cannot be proven.
nodes.retry_policy: Re-evaluate only changed human, budget, graph, artifact or provider reconciliation evidence; preserve usage and accepted artifacts.
nodes.checkpoint_policy: Persist exact state and select resume only after run, SKU, graph, artifacts and side effects are reconciled.

dependency_only_components.reason: Normative dependency used by authoring and QA nodes; standards are not executable actions.
Template and capability-routing dependency used by Prompt Agent, AI Creator and Finishing nodes.
Cross-agent schemas and deterministic validators; individual contracts are dependencies of multiple nodes.
